system.description:
A knight may take to a life of adventure in the process of performing his duties. He might be tasked with locating a missing relic of the order, or charged to go forth and represent the order on the battlefield and to the common folk by display of his skill and courage.

Career Ability:

You have a mighty warhorse, with whom you have a special bond. Take the Battle-Bred Warhorse follower sheet. Should your horse die or be stolen, you lose access to this ability until you form a similar bond with a new horse
system.summary: An exceptional career fighter trained as a heavy cavalryman.
